summary: Rootless Node.js application is running at http://10.100.116.10:8080/ and returns exactly `Hello, world!`. It recovered automatically after node1 rebooted.
actions_performed: Created the nodeapp service account with subordinate UID/GID ranges and lingering enabled.
Created the rootless node-hello container and node-hello.service using Quadlet.
Verified the 13-byte HTTP response on port 8080.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified automatic recovery.

evidence.summary: Both checks report uid=1000(nodeapp) and podman_rootless=true.

evidence.requirement: Container and service are named node-hello and start without an interactive login
evidence.summary: The generated user service is active, Linger=yes, and the node-hello container restarted automatically after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Application returns exactly Hello, world! from / on TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, port 8080 listened on 0.0.0.0 and HTTP / returned status 200 with exactly 13 bytes and hex 48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421.

Healthy baseline boot ID f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID a9ac2871-1f65-438a-9249-ea7e406333c3 was observed, and service/container/HTTP recovery was proven.
